entities.summary: Jovana Rapport is a Serbian chess player who has represented Hungary since 2024. She holds the title of Woman Grandmaster (WGM), which FIDE awarded her in 2009. She is a two-time Montenegrin women's champion and also a Serbian women's champion (2014).
